edges.reason: actual two-face O-shell edge supplied as low-quality refinement target; not one of the 145 crossing edges and not a bone-crossing claim

limitations: The 145 inherited rows and new quality row are source-path proposals only; exact full mesh and all material/clearance gates remain required.

No fixed layer thickness is introduced. O/I/D suggestions use existing endpoint scalar layer depths projected onto fine source normals; two crossing-edge rows retain negative endpoint depth witnesses from source data and these are not clamped.
The row2332 endpoint uses the accepted coarse-reference exact face and barycentrics; its represented detailed source point remains 1.413mm from the compact coarse point and this residual is retained.
The supplied quality threshold is retained as a root-supplied witness and is not independently recomputed in this script.
